question: Can you send my order to my mailbox at the post office?
answer: Yes, we can ship to a PO Box, but only using the standard postal service. Our expedited carriers (FedEx, UPS, etc.) don’t deliver to PO Boxes. If you choose standard shipping, delivery to a PO Box typically takes about 7–10 business days. Let me know if you’d like to update your shipping method or need any other assistance!
